task: Asset naming convention (art/NAMING.md) and audit of art/, assets/, media/. No renames, no moves, no commits.
usage_note: Read-only work: find and grep. Excluded handoffs/archive/, gdd-log.md and gdd-process.md; gdd.md only grepped. Meter figure not reported this session: UNKNOWN.
open_questions: D1 Accept the sequence exception so sun_00..sun_63 keep their names (64 files), or rename to sun_flare_NN (also edits sun_flare.gd and cut_sun.gd).
D2 Which sun sheet is the master (sun_sheet_v01 or v02)? cut_sun.gd expects 'Solar Flare Evolution Sprite Sheet.png', which is not in the repo.

D3 Keep or delete the unreferenced assets: route_arrow.png, planet_2.jpg, ui_glyph_* (4), ui_header_horizon, ui_panel_glass, star_bazaar_corvette.glb/.obj, font zips. UNKNOWN whether the artist plans to wire them.
handoff: Convention is in art/NAMING.md (proposal, not applied): snake_case, category prefix from a fixed list, folder = category, two-digit frames and variants, sizes and states from short lists, source sheets in art/source/ with version suffix, media/ is documents and refs only. Audit: 101 raster, model and doc assets; 22 fail name or folder rules (21.8%). 15 are clear renames (sheets, planet_1/2, route arrows, corvette, PDFs, zips, font zips, route_arrow.png location); 7 are hash-named media/refs awaiting a decision. Highest risk: runtime-built names (icon_%s, ui_thumb_%s, arrow_%s, sun_%02d) and the corvette, which the export filter excludes by the assets/star_bazaar_* pattern. Code in art/ (gd, gdshader, tscn, tres, generators) is a folder mismatch, not a naming fault. Doc drift: art/style.md cites art/planets/, which does not exist.
